title: NeoOrigins Action
description: A side-effect action used in `entity_action` fields. The `type` field discriminates.

type.description: Fully-qualified action verb. `apace:` aliases are accepted.

power.description: Power id to activate, as if its key were pressed — condition, cooldown, and fail_action of the target power all apply. The player must currently have the power.

action.description: Inner action to run on the actor (source player).

set.description: Name of the actor's entity-set to add the bientity target's UUID to.
If true, replaces delta movement instead of pushing additively.

space.description: Coordinate space for x/y/z. world = absolute axes (default); local = relative to look direction (+z = forward); velocity = relative to current movement direction. _horizontal variants ignore vertical look/velocity; _normalized variants ignore the base vector's length.

actions.description: List of entity actions to run in order.

effect.description: Single effect id (use this OR effects[]; `id` accepted as a synonym).

duration.description: Effect duration in ticks (default 200; honoured when using the 'effect' scalar).

effects.description: Array of {effect, duration, amplifier, is_ambient, show_particles, show_icon} objects. First entry wins if both 'effect' and 'effects' are present.

entity_action.description: Action run on every caught entity.

entity_condition.description: Optional filter — only entities matching are hit.

include_source.description: Include the caster in the AoE (default true).

block_action.description: Action run at the entity's block position (BlockPos published to context).

action.description: Inner block-target verb to run on the resolved context block (strip/till/path/grow/transform_block).

delivery.description: How the spell is delivered. One of Build A Spell's 5 delivery methods: `rune`, `sight`, `self`, `cast`, `tracking`.

components.description: The ordered component list, EFFECT-FIRST: each effect id is followed by the modifier ids that apply to it (a modifier binds to the PRECEDING effect; one before the first effect is silently dropped). Effect/modifier ids come from Build A Spell; `compat:*` ids pass through verbatim. Easiest path: build the spell in-game and use BaS's "Export to Power" button, which emits this list in the correct order.

target_condition.description: Optional filter — only entities matching are valid targets.

chance.description: Probability in [0,1] that the action runs (default 0.5).

action.description: Action run when the chance roll succeeds.

resource.description: Resource power id (matches the bar's defining power). `*` globs match any stored resource key.

operation.description: add (default) clamps within bar bounds; set assigns directly. Apoli synonyms (add_base, set_total, ...) are accepted.

change.description: Amount to add or value to set (default 0). Apoli's nested `modifier` {operation, amount} shape is also accepted.

actions.description: List of {action, weight} entries; one is picked weighted-randomly.

effect.description: Mob effect id to remove; omit to clear all effects.

source.description: Optional damage source; reads `source.name` (fire/lava/magic/starve/drown/freeze/wither; default generic).

amount.description: Flat damage dealt to the attacker (default 2.0; ignored when amount_ratio is set).

amount_ratio.description: If set, damage = incoming hit * this ratio (min 0.5), overriding amount.

source.description: Optional damage source; reads `source.name` (fire/lava/magic/generic; default magic).

name.description: Damage source name: fire, lava, magic, or generic (default magic).

strength.description: Impulse magnitude along player look vector (default 1.5).

allow_vertical.description: If false, dash is pinned to horizontal (default true).

set_velocity.description: If true, replaces delta movement instead of pushing additively.

ticks.description: Server ticks to wait before running the action (default 1).

action.description: Action run after the delay elapses.

inventory_type.description: Only 'inventory' (the vanilla player inventory) is supported; 'power' inventories no-op.

item_condition.description: Only drop stacks matching this item_condition. Omit to drop everything.

slots.description: Restrict to these vanilla/Apoli slot names (e.g. weapon.mainhand, weapon.offhand, armor.head). Omit or leave empty to scan every slot.

retain_ownership.description: Tag drops with the thrower for pickup priority (default false).

mode.description: 'each' rolls every entry independently; 'one_of' picks one weighted by 'weight'.

rolls.description: Number of weighted picks in one_of mode (default 1; ignored in each mode).

items.description: Drop entries — each: {item, count (int|[min,max]), chance (each-mode), weight (one_of-mode)}.

color.description: Dye colour name to apply to the target (e.g. "red"). Dyes a sheep's wool; non-dyeable targets no-op.

effect.description: Mob effect id to apply to the attacker.

event.description: Game event id to emit (or use the `game_event` alias).

equipment_slot.description: Equipment slot to read the stack from (default mainhand).

action.description: ItemAction to run on the stack (consume, damage, set-NBT, etc.).

command.description: Command to run at server authority; `~ ~ ~` resolves to the dispatch block when available.

create_fire.description: Spawn fire on affected blocks (default false).

slot.description: Equipment slot to drop from: mainhand/offhand/head/chest/legs/feet (default mainhand).

amount.description: Air-supply ticks to add, clamped to max (default 10).

item.description: Item id to give (or place under `stack.item`).

stack.description: Optional nested item-stack object; its item/count override the flat fields.

item.description: Item id for the stack (e.g. minecraft:diamond).

power.description: Power id to grant (or use the `power_id` alias).

source.description: Apoli-style 'source' label; accepted but ignored by this implementation.

amount.description: Health points to restore (1.0 = half a heart; default 1.0).

condition.description: Entity condition deciding which branch runs (fail-closed when absent).

if_action.description: Action run when the condition passes.

else_action.description: Action run when the condition fails.

actions.description: List of {condition, action} branches; the first passing branch runs.

ticks.description: Fire duration applied to the attacker in ticks (default 60).

item_condition.description: Optional ItemCondition filtering which stacks to process.

item_action.description: ItemAction run on each matching stack.

process_mode.description: items (default) counts individual items; stacks counts whole stacks toward the limit.

limit.description: Cap on items/stacks processed; 0 = no limit (default 0).

entity_type.description: Entity type id to mount; omit to mount any nearby entity.

action.description: Inner action to run (offset is architectural; position comes from context).

x.description: X offset (accepted for Apoli parity; no positional effect here).

y.description: Y offset (accepted for Apoli parity; no positional effect here).

z.description: Z offset (accepted for Apoli parity; no positional effect here).

action.description: Action run on each passenger (or use the `entity_action` alias).

include_players.description: Whether to pull other players (default true).

entity_condition.description: Optional filter on which entities to pull.

horizontal_range.description: Max horizontal teleport distance (or use the `range` alias; default 16.0).

attempts.description: Number of random positions tried before giving up (default 16).

shape_type.description: Block shape for the trace: visual (default) or collider.

block_action.description: Action when a block is hit; ~ ~ ~ resolves to the hit block.

bientity_action.description: Action when an entity is hit (with the hit entity as target context).

miss_action.description: Action when nothing is hit within range.

before_action.description: Entity action run once before the ray is cast, regardless of hit outcome (e.g. consume a reagent).

command_along_ray.description: Optional command run at each step along the ray (fires regardless of hit).

command_at_hit.description: Optional command run at the precise impact point when the ray hits a block or entity.

set.description: Name of the actor's entity-set to remove the bientity target's UUID from.

power.description: Power id to revoke (or use the `power_id` alias).

source.description: Apoli-style 'source' label; accepted but ignored by this implementation.

action.description: Action run on the entity the holder is riding (or use the `entity_action` alias).

selector.description: Vanilla entity selector (e.g. @e[type=area_effect_cloud,tag=foo,limit=2,sort=nearest]) resolved relative to the holder.

bientity_action.description: Action run once per selected entity; the entity is published as the action's source (origin + rotation).

block.description: Block id to place at the player's position.

keep.description: If true, only place when the target position is air (default false).

fall_distance.description: New fall distance value (default 0.0 — resets fall damage).

ticks.description: Fire duration in ticks (default 20 = 1s). Apoli `duration` is also accepted.

resource.description: Resource power id (matches the bar's defining power).

value.description: Value to assign (falls back to `change`; default 0).

damage_per_tick.description: Damage applied per tick to caught entities (default 2.0).

effect.description: Mob effect id (bare string) or object {effect, duration, amplifier}; omit for an empty cloud.

wait_time.description: Ticks before the cloud starts applying its effect (default 10).

entity_type.description: Entity type id to spawn at the player's position.

quantity.description: Number of copies to spawn (default 1; >1 adds ±0.5-block jitter).

entity_action.description: Action run every interval against caught entities.

particle.description: Particle id to spawn (simple/data-less particles only; dust/block/item no-op).

force.description: Apoli force-render flag (accepted; the server always broadcasts).

offset_y.description: Vertical offset from the player's feet (default 0).

on_hit_action.description: Action run when the projectile hits something.

projectile_action.description: Entity action applied to the spawned projectile itself (actor = projectile), immediately on launch.

effect_type.description: Visual palette id for MagicOrb projectiles (client-side). Sets defaults for color/shape/trail_particle; explicit fields below override it.

orb_color.description: Core orb color. Accepts an RGB array [r,g,b] (0-255) or a hex string "#RRGGBB". Overrides the effect_type color.

glow_color.description: Outer-glow color (RGB array [r,g,b] or hex "#RRGGBB"). Defaults to the orb_color when omitted.

shape.description: Procedural orb shape (default cross / effect_type default).

trail_particle.description: Vanilla particle id for the flight trail (e.g. minecraft:witch). Overrides the effect_type trail.

count.description: Number of projectiles to fire (default 1; combine with divergence for a spread). For MagicOrb projectiles this keeps its legacy meaning: trail particles emitted per tick.

tag.description: SNBT compound merged onto each spawned projectile (e.g. "{pickup:1b}" so fired arrows can be picked up).

no_gravity.description: If true the projectile ignores gravity and flies straight along its launch vector (default false).

radius.description: Radius of the disk the projectiles rain across (default 6.0).

duration_ticks.description: How long the storm lingers before fading (default 70).

count.description: Number of projectiles in the storm (default 16). Legacy alias: sword_count.

damage_per_impact.description: Damage each landing projectile deals to foes near it (default 4.0). Legacy alias: damage_per_sword. Ignored when impact_action is set.

knockup.description: Upward velocity applied to struck foes (default 0.5).

impact_radius.description: Horizontal radius of each projectile's hit (default 2.0).

weapon_damage_scale.description: Per-blade bonus = this × the caster's attack-damage attribute (folds in the held weapon), captured at cast time. 0 = flat damage.

impact_action.description: Composable action run at each blade's landing point against entities within impact_radius. When set it REPLACES the built-in damage/knockup; omit to keep the default damage.

model.description: Which falling-blade model the client renders. Built-in: 'sword' (spectral blade). Unknown ids fall back to 'sword'. Ignored when 'projectile' is set (real entities draw themselves).

projectile.description: Real entity-type id to rain instead of the baked-mesh blade (e.g. minecraft:arrow, minecraft:trident). Each scatter point spawns this ACTUAL entity from the sky to fall under real physics; impact_action becomes its on-hit (caster-owned). Unknown/unset id keeps the spectral-blade visual.

projectile_speed.description: Initial downward launch speed of each rained entity; gravity then accelerates it (default 1.0). Only used when 'projectile' is set.

spawn_height.description: Blocks above each scatter point the entity spawns from (default 18.0). Only used when 'projectile' is set.

tag.description: SNBT compound merged onto each rained entity (e.g. "{pickup:1b}" so fired arrows can be picked up). Only used when 'projectile' is set.

follow_terrain.description: When true (default) each blade/projectile lands on the surface Y under its own scatter point (MOTION_BLOCKING heightmap), so the storm follows hills/stairs instead of all dropping on one flat plane. Set false to lock every drop to the storm center's Y.

origin.description: Where the storm centers: 'self' (around caster), 'look' (what the caster aims at), or 'impact' (projectile hit point).

radius.description: Radius of the marked danger zone (default 3.0).

duration_ticks.description: Wind-up length: ticks the reticle takes to contract before it expires (default 20).

on_expire.description: Composable action run once when the wind-up ends, against entities within radius (caster excluded). Omit for a pure dodge cue with no payoff.

origin.description: Where the marker centers: 'self' (at caster), 'look' (what the caster aims at), or 'impact' (projectile hit point).

move_speed.description: Blocks/tick the funnel drifts forward along the caster's facing (0 = stationary; default 0.2).

gravity.description: When true the funnel falls under gravity until its base hits the ground, so a tornado spawned in mid-air drops while it drifts forward (default false = hovers at spawn height).

impact_action.description: Composable action run on each damage-interval tick against every entity caught inside the funnel's inner radius. When set it REPLACES the built-in damage_per_interval; omit to keep the default damage.

slot.description: Equipment slot to steal from: mainhand/offhand/head/chest/legs/feet (default mainhand). Item goes to the actor's inventory, or drops at the actor if full.

target_condition.description: Optional entity condition; applied to player candidates (default always-true).

max_tamed.description: Max tamed mobs alive at once (shared with tame_mob via the MinionTracker) before this action no-ops. Default 4.

max_distance.description: Crosshair search distance used only when no context target resolves (default 5.0).

despawn_ticks.description: Ticks a tamed mob lasts before despawning (36000 = 30 min).

death_damage.description: Damage dealt to the player when a tamed mob dies (half-hearts).

hostile_only.description: When true (default), only mobs implementing Enemy can be tamed. Set false to allow any non-player Mob.

entity_blacklist.description: Entity ids ("minecraft:warden") and tag refs ("#mymod:untameable") this action can never tame. The Warden, Ender Dragon and Wither plus the tame_scare_entity_blacklist config list are always excluded.

action.description: Inner action to run on the resolved context target (player → full action; mob → entity-general subset).

position.description: Absolute target {x, y, z}; when present, overrides the dx/dy/dz offset.

force.description: Horizontal push magnitude applied to the target (default 1.5).

vertical_lift.description: Upward push applied to the target (default 0.5).

max_distance.description: Max crosshair search distance for a target (default 5.0).

power.description: Power id whose toggle state to flip (or set).

value.description: If present, sets the toggle to this value instead of flipping it.

from.description: Optional block id guard; only transform when the impacted block matches (e.g. "minecraft:stone").

to.description: Block id to set the impacted block to (e.g. "minecraft:gold_block").

power.description: Power id whose cooldown to start.

oneOf.$comment: Fallback branch — any registered type not exhaustively schema'd yet. Allows extra fields permissively.
